title: Adyen - Unified enterprise payments, data, and financial products platform
clean_text: Adyen is a fintech platform unifying payment processing, risk management, and acquiring on a single system, organized around three pillars: Digital, Unified Commerce, and Platforms. It targets medium-to-large enterprises in e-commerce, retail, travel, and hospitality with high transaction volumes, generally requiring $500K+ in monthly processing volume, and the Platforms segment also serves marketplaces (eBay, Etsy) and POS software providers (Toast, Lightspeed) that embed payments for their own SMB users; Platforms volume grew 51% year-over-year in 2024.
